faq.question: What is a SaaS demo video?
faq.answer: A short video that shows your product working: the problem it solves, how it's used and why it's worth it. Instead of a raw screen recording, I animate the UI with motion graphics so it makes sense in seconds.

faq.question: How is it different from a SaaS explainer video?
faq.answer: An explainer video usually relies on characters and illustrations. A product demo video shows your real interface and real data, which is what convinces a technical buyer.

faq.question: How long is the video?
faq.answer: Between 15 and 90 seconds depending on the format. For a product launch video I recommend 30 to 60 seconds: enough to show the product, short enough to be watched in full on social.

faq.question: What do you need from me?
faq.answer: Access to the product or a test account, your brand guidelines and a short call for the brief. I take care of the script, the animation and the edit.

faq.question: How long does it take?
faq.answer: It depends on the format and the revisions. Before we start we agree on a delivery date so the video is ready in time for your launch.

founder.title: From scattered posting to a system that runs every morning
founder.subtitle: How I build a content system for your team, step by step.

steps.title: Audit
steps.pain: "We post when we remember"
steps.action: I review your channels, your best posts and who you want as clients.
steps.result: Clear sources, niche and goals for the system.

steps.title: Design
steps.pain: "We don't know what to automate"
steps.action: I map which steps the system does (finding, writing, scheduling) and which stay human.
steps.result: A plan you approve before anything is built.

steps.title: Build
steps.pain: "We tried tools and they didn't stick"
steps.action: I build it with Claude, Apify and a publishing API, with your voice, formats and brand.
steps.result: A working system, tested on your real content.

steps.title: Handover
steps.pain: "We need it to keep working without you"
steps.action: I document it and train your team on the daily routine: review, approve, publish.
steps.result: A routine that takes minutes a day.

faq.question: Will you sell me your radar as it is?
faq.answer: No. I build a version for your team: your niche, your ideal clients, your voice and the networks you use. The idea is the same; the setup is yours.

faq.question: Does it automate actions on my LinkedIn account?
faq.answer: No. It reads public posts to find ideas and opportunities, and it never sends connection requests or messages for you. Publishing goes through a scheduling API, and only after you approve each post.

faq.question: What does it cost to run every month?
faq.answer: Very little. Data collection fits in Apify's free plan for most teams, launches come from free feeds, and the rest is your Claude plan plus a publishing API plan.

faq.question: Does my team need to code?
faq.answer: No. I set everything up. Day to day, your team opens one app, reviews the drafts and approves what goes out.

faq.question: Which networks can it publish to?
faq.answer: LinkedIn, Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Threads, Bluesky and more, depending on the accounts you connect.
